rubric_scores.evidence: The compartment is recognizable through the triple bunk, lockers, equipment cabinet, benches, column, wall equipment, exposed beams and hanging lamps. Details are substantially simplified.
Left foreground equipment and bunks, rear lockers and desk, and the right foreground column retain the principal spatial ordering. The room appears less cramped than the reference.
Major furniture and architectural proportions remain functionally recognizable, although the bunks look broad and the desk and chair comparatively small.
Reddish flooring, pale walls, dark frames and equipment, green benches, white bedding and the red wall fixture preserve the main color organization.
The interior and main furnishings remain legible with coherent shading. Lighting is flatter and less atmospheric than the reference, and substantial noise reduces surface clarity.
Complementary views reveal furniture thickness, cylindrical rails, room depth and changing occlusion, establishing actual three-dimensional construction.

The scene contains 153 meshes with addressable hierarchies. Architectural Box meshes, mattress Box.009, locker Box.015 and column Rod have valid nonempty geometry and assigned materials with connected surface shaders.

dimension_scores.evidence: Strong correspondence of major furnishings and colors; simplified ceiling services and reduced clutter weaken the shipboard character.
The bunk frame is coherent, but mattresses appear inset from supporting rails without visible platforms, and the left bench passes into the equipment cabinet.
The characteristic palette is retained, but bedding, heater and furniture silhouettes are very boxy and simplified.
Heavy render noise, rigid rectangular bedding and sparse construction details make the scene look like a rough model.
Principal left/right and front/rear relationships correspond, while the open floor and simplified background reduce the reference's dense enclosure.
Column and room proportions are plausible; broad bunks and comparatively small seating weaken relative scale consistency.
Readable illumination and consistent shadows support the forms, but noisy, similar surface responses and weak lamp emphasis reduce material distinction and atmosphere.
Most major objects are represented, including three bunk levels, lockers, benches, desk, chair and wall fixtures. Smaller equipment and overhead service complexity are sparse.

same_model_bias_limit: Research and independent judge use Astra; separate sessions do not establish human independence.
